evidence_census.scope: This Surface generation makes tracked-source claims; authenticated acceptance remains audit evidence rather than a Surface input.

evidence_sources.observation: The store implements hash-chained append-only events, derived-state reconciliation, exact seal preconditions, bounded slices and neighborhoods, workflow templates, and stable streaming blob rebuilds.
The supervisor enforces leased execution, restart reconciliation, bounded journal and provider output, exact route manifests, and typed terminal failure.
Octopus import and governed workflow boundaries execute, while the complete authenticated German native-role exchange remains blocked by provider qualification.
The cockpit exposes response-first manual routing, exact context preflight and reconstruction, bounded lineage, workflow live views, and reusable path extraction.
The test suite carries independently authored oracles, properties, regressions, contracts, concurrency checks, and deliberately failing negative siblings across the remediation surface.
The canonical workframe contract states Loom's telos, boundaries, current acceptance, and known incomplete German workflow.
Workflow tests exercise authoritative reads, exact state receipts, rejected mutation authority, query freezing, idempotency, restart ambiguity, bounded inputs, and Platform Foundry reuse.

claims.summary: Loom durably stores a hash-chained append-only lattice, seals immutable context manifests with compare-and-swap, reconstructs locally observable context independently, and exposes bounded replay, diff, slice, and neighborhood operations.
Qualified subscription CLIs execute through leased, restart-safe attempts with bounded journaled I/O, authority-bound manifests, typed failures, and explicit provider-owned opacity.

Octopus exact-source import, declarative governed workflows, quaternary and Platform Foundry live projections, Slate slices, and Axial projection execute; complete authenticated German native-role acceptance remains unproven.

The same-origin cockpit supports manual one-edge routing, fork and join trailheads, exact preflight and manifest views, governed live views, reusable path discovery, and explicit partial, empty, unavailable, and failure states.
The installable wheel includes the cockpit and workflow packs, and the full local assurance suites pass; a fresh immutable post-remediation audit is still being issued.
